summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into two letter agreements with Hazel Partners Holdings, LLC, its lender under an existing working capital credit facility. The agreements provided negligible advances of $0.05 million and $0.06 million for operating expenses under the discretionary Operational Collection Floor. The facility is not committed, has no borrowing base, and funding is solely at Hazel's discretion. No terms suggest a special situation; the filing covers routine credit facility amendments and direct financial obligations. No special-situation analysis applies; watch for ongoing liquidity constraints, but no event-based corporate action is presented.
